description: A real sun as the key: in a world with its own sun (golden_field) it takes that sun over (its direction and colour stay the world's, set by timeOfDay and sunAzimuthDeg) and makes it crisp; elsewhere it adds a low sun of its own at elevationDeg, from the side and behind the subject. A soft bounce card fills the shadow side (fillRatio) and an optional rim (rim) traces the silhouette. Golden hour, sunsets and dusk courtyards.
